harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /srv/data as a persistent XFS filesystem on an LVM volume with copy-on-write snapshots. Captured baseline data, modified it, restored the earlier snapshot exactly, created a fresh recovery snapshot, and verified everything survives a node reboot.
actions_performed: Created loop-backed LVM volume vgsrv/data and mounted it at /srv/data.
Configured automatic loop attachment, LVM activation, and filesystem mounting at boot.
Created baseline application data and recorded its SHA-256 hashes.
Created snapshot data_baseline, then edited, deleted, and added files.
Merged data_baseline to restore the exact earlier state.
Verified all original hashes and content, including removal of post-snapshot artifacts.
Created active snapshot data_recovered for ongoing recoverability.
Restarted node1 once and verified the changed boot identity, mount, snapshot, services, and data.

evidence.requirement: Application data is stored on a snapshot-capable filesystem under /srv/data
evidence.summary: Shows the XFS data LV mounted at /srv/data, persistent boot configuration, and active LVM snapshot data_recovered.

evidence.requirement: An earlier snapshot captured the original content
evidence.summary: Records the original tree, contents, hashes, and active data_baseline snapshot.

evidence.requirement: The directory was modified after the snapshot
evidence.summary: Shows changed hashes, an added artifact, a deleted file, and snapshot COW utilization.

evidence.requirement: Restore the exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: Snapshot merge reached 100%; the LV remounted; all baseline hashes match, the deleted file returned, and the added artifact is absent.

Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 6ad278cb-74ed-4214-92f4-e05d6c922c00, and recovered services, mount, snapshot, and matching data hashes.
